evals.name: whole-function
evals.prompt: In inventory.c, make the function `report` readable. Don't change anything else in the file.
evals.expected_output: report() is flattened (early continue or guard clauses), the nested ?: is gone, names say what they hold, and `flags & 1 == 1` keeps its meaning `flags & (1 == 1)`, either parenthesized as such or folded to the same test, with the reasoning in the report. Nothing outside report() changes.
assertions: the guard passes against the original file with report() as the region
verify reports no errors (parse, dialect, names, frozen)
report() reaches tier 1, or the report explains every tier 2 review item
the test `flags & 1 == 1` keeps its current meaning, and the report says what that meaning is
the report follows the template in SKILL.md

evals.name: line-range
evals.prompt: Lines 47-74 of netio.c, inside handle_packet, are hard to follow. Clean up just that block and leave the rest of the file alone.
evals.expected_output: The frame loop reads as named steps; any helper goes in the slot before handle_packet; the locals k and c that the code after the range does not use may be renamed only if they stay correct for the code before the range. Lines 28-46 and 75-81 do not change.
assertions: the guard passes with the line range and its helper slot as the regions
verify reports no errors (parse, dialect, names, frozen)
every tier 2 review item is explained in the report
no C99 construct is introduced (the file has none)
the report follows the template in SKILL.md

evals.name: two-functions-crlf-cp1251
evals.prompt: Untangle read_weight and is_stable in legacy.c.
evals.expected_output: Both functions read better; the CHECK macro (which hides a goto) stays in read_weight; is_stable keeps returning TRUE or FALSE values; the file keeps CRLF line endings and its CP1251 comments byte for byte.
assertions: the guard passes against the original file with both functions as regions
the bytes outside the regions are identical, CRLF and CP1251 included
verify reports no errors (parse, dialect, names, frozen)
CHECK stays in read_weight and is not moved into a helper
the report follows the template in SKILL.md
